title: A black hole of 10⁸ kg evaporates in the simulation (Hawking radiation, textbook model)
note: Its lifetime is 2.665437 years; it vanished 0.031 days after, within one step (1.000 days). Halfway, its mass was the formula's to 10⁻⁹. Hawking radiation itself has never been observed.
